name: RC-B10-0452/2026 – After § 6 – Am 2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text: 6a. Stresses that recent US-Israeli military attacks have dramatically worsened the human rights situation in Iran, including by violating the right to life of thousands of Iranian civilians; calls therefore for the EU to support accountability for human rights violations through multilateral UN-based mechanisms and to firmly condemn any threat or use of force in violation of international law and the UN Charter;
